name: Netorare ~Tsuma no Himitsu Otto no Himitsu~
original_name: ネトラレ ～妻の秘密・夫の秘密～
source:
She kept it from him...
Her infidelity, her forbidden affair with another man.

He kept it from her...
His knowledge of her affair, and the secret photos he took of them.

Husband and wife live out a complex, dishonest relationship. His sick voyeurism... her unfaithful loins...

---
An erotic cuckoldry adventure.
View the game contents through the lens of a camera.
Every day you'll see something new, but if you're caught...
It's all over for everybody. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE071626.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
她一直瞒着他……
瞒着自己的不贞，也瞒着那段与另一个男人之间的禁忌恋情。

他也一直瞒着她……
瞒着自己早已知晓她的婚外情，也瞒着那些暗中拍下的照片。

夫妻二人在复杂的谎言中共同生活。他病态的偷窥癖……她渴求他人的肉体……

——
一部以寝取为主题的色情冒险游戏。
透过相机镜头窥见游戏中的一切。
每天都会有新的发现，可一旦被人察觉……
所有人的人生都将彻底完蛋。
